author: Michael Larabel
description: Framework Computer began informing those that pre-ordered the new Framework Laptop 13 Pro that it will begin shipping in July rather than their original June target. The setback is coming to address two issues that came up in their testing process that delayed the start of mass production...
title: Framework Laptop 13 Pro To Begin Shipping In July

author: Michael Larabel
description: Just a week after the release of Intel XPU Manager 1.3.7, Intel today released XPU Manager 2.0 as a major overhaul for this software for monitoring and management of their data center GPUs on Microsoft Windows and Linux...
title: Intel XPU Manager 2.0 Overhauls Windows & Linux Management For Arc Pro GPUs

author: Michael Larabel
description: An important one-liner is set to come for Linux 7.2 to enable ESWIN SoC support by default for RISC-V kernel builds. This change will allow default RISC-V kernel builds in turn to boot on the likes of SiFive's HiFive Premier P550 developer board...
title: Linux 7.2 To Enable ESWIN SoC Support By Default For RISC-V Kernel Builds

author: Michael Larabel
description: Lemonade, the local AI server solution developed by AMD that is designed to work across their CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs, is out with a new version today that also adds NVIDIA CUDA support...
title: AMD's Lemonade SDK For Local AI Adds NVIDIA CUDA Support

author: Michael Larabel
description: After recently noticing the Intel Arc B580 performing better on Linux 7.1 for that kernel version soon to be released as stable, I was curious if there were performance gains also to be found with the new flagship Arc Pro B70 BMG-G31 workstation graphics card. Here are some benchmarks of the Intel Arc Pro B70 in relevant workloads between Linux 7.0 and the near-final Linux 7.1 kernel.
title: Intel Arc Pro B70 Showing Off Some Performance Wins With Linux 7.1

author: Michael Larabel
description: The Linux Foundation continues working to get more involved in new AI initiatives. Today the Linux Foundation announced the OpenSharing Project with an effort to standardize AI asset and data exchange...
title: Linux Foundation's Latest AI Effort Is Around AI Asset & Data Exchange

author: Michael Larabel
description: NVIDIA engineer Kyrylo Tkachov posted a patch for testing yesterday to significantly reduce the amount of time it takes the GNU Compiler Collection (GCC) for conducting a native bootstrap. The time spent in the configure process for native GCC builds is reduced by around 43% while the overall bootstrap wall time is lowered by around 15%...
title: NVIDIA Engineer Devises Patch To Significantly Reduce GCC Bootstrap Time

author: Michael Larabel
description: The cros_ec Linux kernel driver is used for supporting the ChromeOS Embedded Controller "EC" used by Chromebooks and various other laptops like Framework Laptops. With patches pending to cros_ec, support for custom fan curves is being introduced...
title: Linux's CrOS EC Driver To Support Custom Fan Curves - Useful For Framework Laptops

author: Michael Larabel
description: Open-source developer Jakub Okoński has been working on comparing the gaming latency between Linux and Windows and in turn working to drive some improvements into KDE's KWin Wayland compositor so the latency is more competitive with the gaming experience under Microsoft Windows 11...
title: KDE KWin Patches Aiming To Optimize Gaming Latency To Better Compete With Windows
